svg.aria-label: Primary Mission: Verity Lex, live. Everyone is selling AI to government. Who has checked whether government is ready to buy? Scores a California superior court's AI readiness from its own public record, against Rule of Court 10.430, Gov. Code 68150, and Rule of Court 10.500. An agentic scan gathers evidence. A deterministic rule engine assigns the score. The AI reads the record. It never assigns the score.
